name: 3.8 Twin-Turbo V6
notes: Variant: US-market Nissan GT-R (R35), MY2017 update onward (MY2017-2024 base/Premium, VR38DETT 3,799 cc, 565 hp at 6,800 rpm; the 600 hp NISMO is not modelled) with the dual-clutch sequential 6-speed rear transaxle (4.056/2.301/1.595/1.248/1.001/0.796) and the 3.700 rear final drive. The gear ratios, the final drives (front 2.937, rear 3.700) and the 285/35ZRF20 rear tyre are identical on every NissanNews GT-R specification page read (MY2012-2016, 2017, 2018, 2023, 2024; base, NISMO and Track Edition). ATTESA E-TS AWD with the gearbox and transfer in the rear transaxle: the gearbox final drive (3.700) turns the rear axle, so overall ratio = gear x 3.700 and the driven tyre is the rear 285/35ZRF20 run-flat, written 285/35ZR20 (the tyre-code pattern has no run-flat marker; same dimensions). The front axle (front differential 2.937, fed through the transfer) is not modelled. Layout: 60-degree V6 (owner's manual: '6-cylinder, V-slanted at 60°'); the owner's manual cylinder-numbering figure puts cylinders 1/3/5 on one bank and 2/4/6 on the other, numbered from the front. bank 0 = cylinders 1/3/5 (the bank containing cylinder 1; the right bank viewed from the driver's seat as drawn in that figure), bank 1 = cylinders 2/4/6. Firing order 1-2-3-4-5-6 at the even 720/6 = 120 deg interval (60-degree V6, first principles) alternates banks: bank 0 at 0/240/480, bank 1 at 120/360/600. Aspiration: two IHI turbochargers, one per bank ('An IHI turbocharger is mounted on each bank of the engine') -> parallel. RPM: redline = limiter rpm = 7,100, Nissan's published 'Maximum engine speed' for MY2017-on (NissanNews 2017, 2018, 2023 and 2024 specifications); the MY2012-2016 pages list 7,000 rpm (pre-update figure, not used); no separate tachometer red-line figure is published (owner's manual: 'Do not rev the engine into the red zone', no number). shiftTimeS 0.15 s = Nissan's documented R-mode gear change ('performs gear changes in just 0.15 seconds when in R-Mode'), used instead of the 0.10 s DCT default. Estimated (not published in the sources used): idle 700 rpm (owner's manual: 'Idle speed - No adjustment is necessary', no figure); limiter type fuel-hard and 150 rpm hysteresis at the published 7,100 rpm maximum engine speed. EPA Test Car List MY2019-2021 'GT-R' and MY2023-2024 'GT-R Premium' (565 hp, 6-gear automated manual, top gear ratio < 1): axle 3.7, N/V 36.5; model 6th 0.796 x 3.700 on 285/35ZR20 = 36.64 rpm/mph (+0.4 %). EPA's drive-system field reads '2-Wheel Drive, Rear' for this AWD car (EPA data-entry quirk); the MY2017-2018 rows list the 530 hp test vehicle MNE291 carried over from MY2015-2016, with the same axle 3.7 and N/V 36.5.
